question: Rank account owners by the MRR of their active subscriptions.
source: seeded from the golden set; replace with live recordings (ASKDB_LIVE=1 ASKDB_RECORD=1)
replies:
{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: Rank account owners by the MRR of their active subscriptions.", "sql": "SELECT c.account_owner, SUM(s.mrr) AS total_mrr
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.status = 'active'
GROUP BY c.account_owner
ORDER BY total_mrr DESC"}
